item.description:
Belay 1.8.0

  • See stats for each project. Double-click a session in Statistics to see agent time, sessions, tokens and recent runs for that folder.
  • Background tasks hold more reliably. Late or duplicate hook events no longer end a hold early or restart one after release.
  • Hooks recover after an interrupted quit. If Belay is killed while closing, it restores its agent settings on the next launch.
  • The diagnostics log stays small. Once it passes 3 MB, Belay trims it back to the most recent 1 MB.

Also: Sessions now keeps the latest 100 runs, and its headline shows total agent time instead of the number of rows.

Belay 1.7.0

  • See what your agents are doing. Working sessions now show small activity badges like shell, editing and search. Categories only, never your prompts or code.
  • Background tasks keep the hold. If agents or shell jobs keep running after a turn ends, Belay keeps your Mac awake and shows a background-task badge.
  • Hooks clean up automatically. Belay removes its entries when it quits and restores them on launch, so closed Belay never leaves agents pointing at a dead connection.
  • Return summaries are more reliable. Closing the lid no longer hides the while-you-were-away summary, and it now mentions if your Mac ran hot.

Also: dark wakes no longer look like stalls in diagnostics, and sessions taking turns no longer flood the log.

Belay 1.6.4

  • Precise Detection reconnects itself. If the connection to an agent breaks during sleep, Belay restores it when your Mac wakes. No relaunch needed.
  • Long tool calls keep holding. Rapid back-to-back activity no longer interrupts the hold during a long build or test run.
  • One summary when you come back. If Belay kept your Mac awake while you were away, it shows how long it held and how many runs finished. Statistics now also has a sortable list of recent sessions.
  • A few rough edges are fixed. Statistics no longer flicker on hover, and an Until time that has already passed no longer starts a timer for tomorrow.

Also: watched Cline sessions end when their files disappear, old imported conversations no longer look active, and diagnostics stay fully off when Local Reports is off.

Belay 1.6.3

  • Precise Detection survives restarts and updates. Belay now keeps the same local address, so agents stay connected when the app restarts or updates.
  • Option reveals the longer choices too. In Sleep delay and the Always On timer, hold Option or Shift to show the longer durations.

Also: diagnostics now record when the local bridge starts, which port it uses, and which agent settings it updates.

Belay 1.6.2

  • Long-running commands keep your Mac awake. Belay now follows silent tests, builds and other tool calls until they actually finish.
  • More sleep-delay options. Hold Shift in the Sleep delay menu to reveal 15 minutes, 30 minutes and 1 hour.
  • Review Precise Detection rules anytime. An agent’s menu now opens Rules… without making you remove detection first.

Also: repeated diagnostics messages now back off instead of flooding the log.
